verdict.rationale: Google's own docs describe a basic organization feature: you can touch and hold a code and drag it to reorder the list. You can also edit the username label on each code. Nothing in the pack shows search, folders or groups, or service icons, so support for managing dozens of tokens is minimal. Missing for 10: search, folders/groups, service icons, any evidence that it scales to dozens of tokens.

support.subject: As a power user, I can keep dozens of tokens organized — search, folders or groups, and service icons — so the right code is always two taps away

citations.quote: To organize your Authenticator codes, touch and hold any code, then drag to reorder to a desired location.
You can update the username for the code or change the associated Google Account where that code is saved.
